Summary: PNE-001 | Only the owner and currently authorized collaborators may retrieve each evidence object.
Description:
SR-001: For every list/download route, server-side authorization shall evaluate the signed-in principal against that specific evidence ID and current share grants.
Acceptance: Two users: owner and grantee succeed; a third authenticated user and anonymous request receive 403 or non-disclosing 404; enumeration exposes no file content.
Planned test: T-001 Authorization integration test with 3 accounts + negative HTTP evidence
CIA: C,I / Assets: A-03/A-04/A-05
Threat link: TBD during Phase 3.

Summary: PNE-002 | Only the evidence owner may grant access to a named existing user.
Description:
SR-002: Share endpoint shall require owner permission and a validated target account; reject self/invalid grants without exposing evidence.
Acceptance: Authorized grant succeeds; non-owner and unknown target cannot create grants; database remains unchanged on rejected attempts.
Planned test: T-002 Owner/non-owner grant tests + DB check
CIA: C,I / Assets: A-05/A-04
Threat link: TBD during Phase 3.

Summary: PNE-003 | Revoked collaborators must lose access at the next request.
Description:
SR-003: Revocation shall update server-side grant state and every later download shall recheck current permissions.
Acceptance: After revocation, previously authorized collaborator receives 403/404; owner still succeeds.
Planned test: T-003 Grant → download → revoke → denied regression test
CIA: C,I / Assets: A-05/A-03
Threat link: TBD during Phase 3.

Summary: PNE-004 | Non-owners must not delete or alter evidence objects.
Description:
SR-004: Delete operation shall be owner-only; denied attempts shall not remove metadata, grants, or bytes.
Acceptance: Unauthorized delete rejected and original owner can still download the same file and digest.
Planned test: T-004 Two-account delete integration test
CIA: I,A / Assets: A-03/A-04/A-05
Threat link: TBD during Phase 3.

Summary: PNE-005 | Sensitive operations must require an authenticated user.
Description:
SR-005: Upload, list, download, share, revoke, delete and audit views shall enforce authenticated session checks.
Acceptance: Each protected endpoint rejects unauthenticated requests; authenticated owner workflows succeed.
Planned test: T-005 Authentication route matrix test
CIA: C,I / Assets: A-01/A-02/A-10
Threat link: TBD during Phase 3.

Summary: PNE-006 | Passwords must not be exposed in source, logs or stored as plaintext.
Description:
SR-006: Use vetted salted password hashing; never persist plaintext; prevent secrets from being printed.
Acceptance: Database password hash differs from entered password, login verifies it, no source code contains seeded plaintext credentials.
Planned test: T-006 Credential storage test + source inspection
CIA: C / Assets: A-01/A-12
Threat link: TBD during Phase 3.

Summary: PNE-007 | User sessions must resist predictable or cross-site misuse.
Description:
SR-007: Use signed/unpredictable session state, HttpOnly and SameSite cookies, logout invalidation and appropriate expiry; Secure flag under HTTPS.
Acceptance: Logout prevents reuse; cookie attributes are visible; altered tokens are rejected.
Planned test: T-007 Cookie/header inspection and session lifecycle tests
CIA: C,I / Assets: A-02/A-15
Threat link: TBD during Phase 3.

Summary: PNE-008 | Cross-site pages must not silently perform sensitive state changes.
Description:
SR-008: All authenticated browser state-changing forms shall require session-bound anti-CSRF token verification plus SameSite cookies.
Acceptance: Missing/wrong token rejected (403); correct token accepted; GET has no state-changing side effect.
Planned test: T-008 CSRF negative/positive test and controlled forged-form demo
CIA: I / Assets: A-02/A-05/A-10
Threat link: TBD during Phase 3.

Summary: PNE-009 | Sensitive pages must not be operable when embedded by an untrusted site.
Description:
SR-009: Authenticated pages shall emit CSP frame-ancestors 'none' and X-Frame-Options DENY.
Acceptance: Browser refuses to render secure page within cross-origin iframe; secure response headers contain the policy.
Planned test: T-009 Browser iframe demo + response header test
CIA: I / Assets: A-10/A-15
Threat link: TBD during Phase 3.

Summary: PNE-010 | Evidence files must not be publicly available through static web paths.
Description:
SR-010: Store evidence outside static root; access only via authorized server download route.
Acceptance: A guessed direct path cannot retrieve bytes; authorized API download succeeds.
Planned test: T-010 HTTP direct-path negative test + storage inspection
CIA: C / Assets: A-03/A-09/A-10
Threat link: TBD during Phase 3.

Summary: PNE-011 | External identifiers must not reveal paths or grant access by themselves.
Description:
SR-011: Generate opaque evidence IDs and server-controlled storage names; never use client filenames as filesystem path components.
Acceptance: Uploads receive non-sequential random-looking IDs; path-like filenames do not traverse storage.
Planned test: T-011 Upload metadata and path traversal tests
CIA: C / Assets: A-04/A-09
Threat link: TBD during Phase 3.

Summary: PNE-012 | Large uploads must not exhaust service capacity.
Description:
SR-012: Reject oversized uploads with a configured maximum and bounded streaming/storage; clean up failed writes.
Acceptance: Configured over-limit upload rejected, not written to disk; subsequent normal request still succeeds.
Planned test: T-012 Boundary-size integration test and disk inspection
CIA: A / Assets: A-03/A-09/A-13
Threat link: TBD during Phase 3.

Summary: PNE-013 | Untrusted metadata must not corrupt native memory.
Description:
SR-013: Bound and validate native helper input lengths; use bounded memory operations; compile and test helper with AddressSanitizer.
Acceptance: Overlong input terminates safely with non-zero validation error; ASAN reports no overflow for fixed parser.
Planned test: T-013 Controlled legacy/fixed C harness + ASAN output
CIA: I,A / Assets: A-11/A-13
Threat link: TBD during Phase 3.

Summary: PNE-014 | User-supplied values must not become shell commands.
Description:
SR-014: Invoke the fixed native helper through argument arrays with shell disabled; validate input and set timeout.
Acceptance: Shell metacharacter input is treated as data or rejected; marker file/extra command never executes in secure version.
Planned test: T-014 Controlled legacy/fixed command invocation test
CIA: C,I,A / Assets: A-11/A-13
Threat link: TBD during Phase 3.

Summary: PNE-015 | Untrusted filenames and paths must not escape private storage.
Description:
SR-015: Normalize and validate display metadata; use server-generated object storage paths, never client-supplied path segments.
Acceptance: Traversal patterns do not create or read files outside the configured private store.
Planned test: T-015 Traversal negative tests + filesystem assertions
CIA: C,I / Assets: A-03/A-04/A-09
Threat link: TBD during Phase 3.

Summary: PNE-016 | Evidence bytes must have a verifiable integrity reference.
Description:
SR-016: Compute SHA-256 on upload, store digest, and recompute/compare before authorized download or verification.
Acceptance: Original bytes match the stored digest; a deliberately modified test file is flagged as mismatched.
Planned test: T-016 Hash correctness and tamper-detection tests
CIA: I / Assets: A-03/A-06
Threat link: TBD during Phase 3.

Summary: PNE-017 | Security-relevant evidence actions must be accountable.
Description:
SR-017: Record actor, event, evidence ID, outcome and UTC timestamp for upload/share/revoke/download/delete/failed authorization without recording file contents.
Acceptance: Each required event generates a timestamped record tied to actor and object; failures are recorded without file bytes.
Planned test: T-017 Audit event integration test and record screenshot
CIA: I / Assets: A-07/A-04
Threat link: TBD during Phase 3.

Summary: PNE-018 | Audit and error messages must not disclose secrets or evidence contents.
Description:
SR-018: Do not log passwords, session tokens, full file bodies, or secret configuration; use generic client errors.
Acceptance: Known secret/test content strings are absent from generated audit/error logs; 500 response does not show stack trace.
Planned test: T-018 Log redaction and safe-error tests
CIA: C / Assets: A-07/A-12/A-10
Threat link: TBD during Phase 3.

Summary: PNE-019 | Database requests must not permit SQL manipulation by user inputs.
Description:
SR-019: Use parameterized DB operations and validated input; avoid dynamic SQL composition from request values.
Acceptance: SQL metacharacter username/filename does not change query scope, corrupt data, or authenticate falsely.
Planned test: T-019 DB query tests / static code review
CIA: C,I / Assets: A-08/A-10
Threat link: TBD during Phase 3.

Summary: PNE-020 | Invalid file metadata must fail closed without crashing normal workflows.
Description:
SR-020: Validate length, encoding and allowed metadata at the web/native boundary; apply subprocess timeout and nonzero error handling.
Acceptance: Empty/overlong/invalid input rejected with controlled HTTP error; health endpoint stays reachable.
Planned test: T-020 Boundary, malformed-input and timeout tests
CIA: I,A / Assets: A-04/A-11/A-13
Threat link: TBD during Phase 3.

Summary: PNE-021 | Deployment and build secrets must remain private and separately configurable.
Description:
SR-021: Read secrets from environment/secret store; ignore .env and avoid real tokens in repo, images, CI logs and screenshots.
Acceptance: Repository secret scan has no real secret; app refuses unsafe missing production secret; local .env is ignored.
Planned test: T-021 Git ignore inspection + secret scanning
CIA: C,I / Assets: A-12/A-14
Threat link: TBD during Phase 3.

Summary: PNE-022 | High/critical findings must block the secure delivery workflow.
Description:
SR-022: Run tests, SAST and DAST evidence workflow; enforce a nonzero security stage result for verified high/critical findings.
Acceptance: Passing clean run is green; synthetic/known high finding in a controlled test makes required CI check fail.
Planned test: T-022 GitHub Actions/SAST/DAST artifacts, passing and failing screenshots
CIA: I / Assets: A-14/A-10
Threat link: TBD during Phase 3.

Summary: PNE-023 | Security changes must be reviewed and traceable to the need they address.
Description:
SR-023: Protect main; merge via PR with one peer approval; name PNE-ID in issue/PR and link later threat, fix, test records.
Acceptance: Main denies direct push; sample PR has reviewer approval and linked issue/test; actual issue keys saved after creation.
Planned test: T-023 GitHub settings screenshot + real PR screenshot
CIA: I / Assets: A-14/A-16
Threat link: TBD during Phase 3.

Summary: PNE-024 | Service failures must be detectable and startup reproducible.
Description:
SR-024: Provide health endpoint, repeatable Docker Compose configuration, and clear restart/run instructions.
Acceptance: Container starts from documented commands and /health responds; restart returns service to healthy state.
Planned test: T-024 Docker Compose logs + health verification
CIA: A / Assets: A-08/A-09/A-13
Threat link: TBD during Phase 3.

Summary: PNE-025 | Application runtime should minimize privileges.
Description:
SR-025: Run container process as non-root with least required filesystem permissions and avoid privileged mounting.
Acceptance: Inspection shows non-root UID and private writable directory only where required.
Planned test: T-025 Container inspection test
CIA: C,I,A / Assets: A-09/A-13
Threat link: TBD during Phase 3.

Summary: PNE-026 | Remote deployment should protect session and evidence traffic in transit.
Description:
SR-026: For any internet-facing environment, terminate TLS and set Secure cookies; local HTTP is lab-only and must not be called production-ready.
Acceptance: HTTPS request succeeds; HTTP redirects/rejected and browser cookie carries Secure in deployed environment.
Planned test: T-026 Deployment configuration and TLS inspection
CIA: C,I / Assets: A-02/A-03/A-15
Threat link: TBD during Phase 3.

Summary: PNE-027 | Evidence and configuration should be recoverable after storage failures.
Description:
SR-027: Define encrypted backup, restore and integrity-check procedure for DB and file store; test before production use.
Acceptance: Restored dummy evidence metadata and bytes match recorded digest after a rehearsal.
Planned test: T-027 Documented restore drill (future)
CIA: A,I / Assets: A-03/A-08/A-09
Threat link: TBD during Phase 3.

Summary: PNE-028 | Authentication attempts should be resistant to automated guessing.
Description:
SR-028: Introduce per-account/IP login throttling and monitored failure events before broader exposure.
Acceptance: Repeated failed attempts trigger bounded rejection without blocking unrelated accounts.
Planned test: T-028 Rate-limit test (future)
CIA: C,A / Assets: A-01/A-10
Threat link: TBD during Phase 3.

Summary: PNE-029 | Evidence retention and deletion must follow an explicit policy.
Description:
SR-029: Agree retention limits and deletion semantics; prevent unauthorized purge and document backups not necessarily erased by live deletion.
Acceptance: Policy defines retention and delete effect on primary/backup copy; sample deletion verified.
Planned test: T-029 Policy review + cleanup test (future)
CIA: C,I / Assets: A-03/A-07/A-09
Threat link: TBD during Phase 3.

Summary: PNE-030 | Audit records should become tamper-evident for real investigations.
Description:
SR-030: For production, forward audit logs to protected append-only/tamper-evident store; a mutable local SQLite audit table is not tamper-proof.
Acceptance: Attempted modification detectable via protected archive/integrity chain; evidence of independent storage.
Planned test: T-030 Integrity chain test (future)
CIA: I / Assets: A-07
Threat link: TBD during Phase 3.
